title: RoboDojo: A Unified Sim-and-Real Benchmark for Comprehensive Evaluation of Generalist Robot Manipulation Policies
abstract: Generalist robot manipulation policies have made substantial progress, yet existing benchmarks remain limited in their ability to systematically and comprehensively evaluate policy capabilities. RoboDojo is a unified sim-and-real benchmark with 42 simulation tasks (five capability dimensions: Generalization, Memory, Precision, Long-Horizon, Open) and 18 real-world tasks (three embodiments: ARX X5, Piper, Piper X). It implements heterogeneous parallel simulation in Isaac Sim, provides RoboDojo-RealEval for reproducible remote real-world evaluation, and XPolicyLab as a unified policy integration infrastructure. 30 policies are integrated and evaluated, establishing a public leaderboard.
